title: Group-relative policy optimization

paper.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Group-relative policy optimization: train on generated verifiable arithmetic using group-normalized rewards without a value network. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use generated-arithmetic; required output: Arithmetic prompt -> sampled answer and policy log probabilities. Evaluate verified_accuracy (maximize). Exact answer verifier and train/eval operand split; handle zero group reward variance. Required ablation: Compare group-relative and unnormalized rewards with the same sampled completions. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
